body.title: Expose the broker over IPC
body.summary: Register the approval.subscribe stream handler (pushes 'gate' frames, replays pending requests, closes with the socket) and the approval.answer RPC ({ requestId, decision } returning { accepted }) in src/daemon/index.ts against the single broker created at daemon start, and add the frame and method shapes to src/shared/types.ts. The gate.request-permission stub stays. Prove the exchange over the real unix-socket server with the real broker: a client attaches, sees the exact call and answers over its own connection.
acceptanceChecks: a client that opens approval.subscribe receives a gate frame for a pending request and its approval.answer resolves the request
a client that subscribes after the request was raised receives it
an answer for an unknown request id returns accepted false
disconnecting the only subscriber resolves pending requests to no-client
an integration test over the real unix-socket server and the real broker shows a client seeing the exact call and answering over its connection
